archetypes.name: cache-prefix-reviewer
archetypes.rationale: Prompt-order changes can silently fail to improve cache hits or alter reviewer behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan and implementation keep stable reviewer text before per-run paths and context. Check that all original prompt content remains present. Look for dynamic ledger, diff, plan, feature, or scope content that still appears before the stable prefix. Cite repository files and line numbers for every claim. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
